key_insight: Q-GAIN is a modular Python package that streamlines machine-learning and physics-informed analysis for cold-atom imaging, from preprocessing to feature detection and downstream analysis.
engineering_relevance: It offers a reusable workflow for computational physicists to deploy classification and object-detection models on experimental BEC data with minimal custom infrastructure.
method: Loads and preprocesses experimental or benchmark image data
Runs ML tasks such as classification and object detection for feature identification
Combines ML outputs with conventional physics-informed analysis metrics
evidence_signal: The abstract reports three demonstration use cases: MNIST digit classification, soliton detection in time-of-flight data, and vortex detection in ring-shaped BEC images.
watch_item: Performance and robustness likely depend on the quality of the experimental images and task-specific model configuration, so results may not transfer directly across different cold-atom setups.
paper_title: Q-GAIN: A Python Package for Machine Learning and Physically Informed Analysis Applications
